_about: Maps every run outcome OpenAdapt emits to one plain result.
The plain result comes from the precise outcome (transaction_outcome or the Execute terminal outcome), never from the coarse HALTED label alone.
Only an outcome that proves no effect sets may_have_changed=false and safe_to_retry=true.
safe_to_retry means a new attempt cannot duplicate or collide with a write from this attempt. It does not promise the new attempt will succeed.
openadapt_types.plain_outcome reads this file. Other languages can apply the same rules from it: see merge_rules.

done.label: Done and checked
done.meaning: It saved the entry and read the record back to confirm it.

stopped_before_change.label: Stopped before saving
stopped_before_change.meaning: Something didn't match, so it stopped before changing anything and asked a person. Nothing was written.

check_the_record.label: Check the record
check_the_record.meaning: A save may have gone through. A person checks the record before anything is retried.

finished_not_checked.label: Finished, not checked
finished_not_checked.meaning: It did the steps but didn't confirm the saved result.

did_not_finish.label: Didn't finish
did_not_finish.meaning: It couldn't complete the task. The next step says what's known about whether anything was written.

refused.label: Refused
refused.meaning: A rule, an approval, or the right-record check didn't allow the run, so it changed nothing.

sealed.label: Signed receipt
sealed.meaning: OpenAdapt signed a receipt that records what was entered and how it was checked.

local.label: Local run report
local.meaning: A run report on the computer that ran it. OpenAdapt didn't sign it.

none.label: No receipt
none.meaning: Only the status itself backs this result.

merge_rules: 1. Each input value selects one row from sources.<source>.values. A value with no row selects fallbacks.unrecognized.
2. execute_state values listed in in_progress are not results. Report progress instead. The value listed in not_an_outcome adds nothing.
3. Use only the first tier in tiers that has an input. Ignore the lower tiers.
4. When execution_outcome and transaction_outcome are both present, execution_outcome must appear in that transaction row's execution_outcomes list. Otherwise use fallbacks.conflict.
5. Rows in the chosen tier that agree on result: use the first one in precedence order, with may_have_changed true if any row says true and safe_to_retry true only if every row says true.
6. Rows that disagree on result: if every row has may_have_changed=false, use the first one in precedence order. Otherwise use fallbacks.conflict.
7. A row with if_not_dispatched uses that variant only when the caller states dispatched=false.
8. delivery_uncertain=true turns any result except check_the_record into fallbacks.delivery_uncertain.
9. No input at all selects fallbacks.missing.
10. proof=sealed requires an execute_terminal_outcome, because a signed receipt carries one.

transaction_outcome.meaning: Flow's terminal transaction outcome: what the evidence proves about the business effect.

VERIFIED.next_action: Nothing else to do. OpenAdapt read the record back and it matches.

HALTED_BEFORE_EFFECT.next_action: Nothing was written. Look at why it stopped, fix that, then run it again.

RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.next_action: A save may have gone through. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

FAILED_PLATFORM.next_action: OpenAdapt hit a problem before it changed anything, so nothing was written. You can run it again.

CANCELED.next_action: Someone canceled the run before it changed anything, so nothing was written. Run it again when you're ready.

REJECTED_POLICY.next_action: Nothing was written. A rule, an approval, or the right-record check blocked this run. Fix that, then run it again.

COMPLETED_UNVERIFIED.next_action: The steps ran, but nothing confirmed the saved result. Check the record before you count it as done or run it again.

ROLLED_BACK.next_action: OpenAdapt found an extra change and undid it. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

execute_terminal_outcome.meaning: The terminal outcome on an Execute status or receipt.

rolled_back_verified.next_action: OpenAdapt found an extra change and undid it. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

execute_state.meaning: The lifecycle state on an Execute status. Only one state is itself a result.

waiting_for_reconciliation.next_action: A save may have gone through. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

execution_outcome.meaning: Flow's coarse outcome. HALTED alone doesn't say whether anything was written.

agent_status.meaning: The status the OpenAdapt Agent returns to a calling AI agent. It is coarse: prefer the precise outcome when the result carries one.

success.next_action: The steps ran, but this status doesn't show that the saved result was checked. Check the record before you count it as done or run it again.

halt.next_action: It stopped, and this status doesn't show whether anything was saved. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

refused.next_action: Nothing was written. OpenAdapt refused to start this run. Fix the reason it gives, then run it again.

timeout.next_action: No answer came back in time, so a save may have gone through. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

if_not_dispatched.next_action: The run never reached the app, so nothing was written. You can send it again.

error.next_action: It didn't finish, and this status doesn't show whether anything was saved. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

if_not_dispatched.next_action: The run never reached the app, so nothing was written. You can send it again.

connector_status.meaning: The coarse status a Flow connector sends back for one job. Prefer the outcome envelope when it's present.

clinic_tool_status.meaning: The status on a clinic MCP tool result. HALTED here is coarse.

queued.label: Waiting to start
queued.next_action: Wait for it to start. Don't send it again.

running.label: Running
running.next_action: Wait for the result. Don't send it again.

decision_required.label: Waiting for a person
decision_required.next_action: A person needs to decide before it can go on. Don't send it again.

conflict.next_action: The results for this run disagree, so a save may have gone through. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

unrecognized.next_action: OpenAdapt doesn't recognize this result, so a save may have gone through. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

missing.next_action: No outcome came back for this run, so a save may have gone through. Check the record before anyone runs this again.

delivery_uncertain.next_action: OpenAdapt can't tell whether a save reached the system. Check the record before anyone runs this again.
